subject: Audit scope and targeted control extracts—SOC 2 bridge timing
messages:
From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@meridianhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@meridianhealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. To move our internal procurement and security review forward we need the SOC 2 Type II report for Redwood’s most recent period and a short bridge letter. In addition, our audit team is asking for a few targeted extracts beyond the report so they can validate control operation for critical authn/authz controls. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following for the SOC 2 period ending 2026-12-31?

- Bridge letter confirming no material changes in control environment since the report date (signed PDF)
- MFA/authn event slices for service and human accounts covering Oct–Nov 2026 (we only need sampled slices, not full retention)
- SAML assertion traces and sample SSO IdP logs for Nov 2026 (time-window: 2026-11-10 through 2026-11-20)
- Privileged access recertification evidence (owner attestations for admin roles) for Q4 2026
- KMS/key rotation entries (audit trail) for customer-key operations in the same period

I've attached a short SIG/controls spreadsheet with our mapping to SOC 2 controls (Meridian_SIG_questions.xlsx). Our audit window is flexible but procurement asks we receive the bridge letter and confirmation of deliverables this week so we can book the external assessor.

Can you also confirm the expected delivery method (secure Drive link vs. shared SFTP) and whether there are any redaction requirements on your side?

Thanks — Elaine

--
Elaine Turner
Security & Privacy Manager
Meridian Health
elaine.turner@meridianhealth.com
security@meridianhealth.com

Attachment: Meridian_SIG_questions.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts request

Hi Elaine —

Thanks, and great to meet on the call. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a signed bridge letter for the 2026-12-31 period. We can also deliver the targeted extracts you outlined, with a few clarifying questions so we scope exactly what your assessor needs:

1) MFA/authn slices: do you need every auth event for Oct–Nov 2026 or a sample of successful/failed MFA events grouped by user type (human vs service)? We typically provide CSV slices with columns: timestamp, user_id (hashed), event_type, result, auth_method.
2) SAML/SSO logs: we can export assertion traces for the requested window. Confirm whether you need whole-assertion XML blobs or a parsed CSV (the latter strips PII).
3) Privileged recert: our normal package is recert attestation screenshots + an exports CSV with role, owner, attestation timestamp.
4) KMS rotation entries: we can provide KMS audit log entries showing rotation operations and key metadata.

Delivery: we prefer a secure, time-limited Drive folder (we'll provide viewer-only links). For high-sensitivity files we can SFTP if required.

Timeline: assuming the questions above are clarified, we can deliver the bridge letter and initial artifact bundle by end of day Monday (2027-02-22). MFA and SAML slices will be pseudonymized by default; if your assessor requires raw identifiers we'll need a signed NDA amendment.

I'll start the exports once we confirm the sample criteria. I've cc'd Markus and Karthik to coordinate infra extractions and signing.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_2026-12-31.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts request

Looping in infra / ops request: Karthik, can you schedule a short run to extract the MFA/authn slices and SAML assertion traces for the specific windows Naomi noted. Priorities:

- MFA/authn slice: focus on Oct 1–Nov 30 2026; include both success/fail events; pseudonymize user ids unless Elaine confirms they need raw ids. Output format: CSV (UTF-8) with header.
- SAML traces: extract assertion timestamps and assertion IDs; tee full XML blobs to secure bucket and produce a parsed CSV for the assessor.
- KMS rotation events: export Cloud KMS audit entries tagged public_key_ops and rotation events for Oct–Dec 2026.

I expect these extracts to take ~3 business days to run / redact. Naomi — please advise if we should prioritize getting the bridge letter signed first (I can route to legal). Also note: if assessor requests mapping to specific SOC 2 CC criteria we should include a short control narrative (1–2 paragraphs) per artifact.

-Markus

--
Markus Klein
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@meridianhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@meridianhealth.com
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 17:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts request

Naomi / team —

Appreciate the quick follow-ups. Meridian confirms the assessor is fine with pseudonymized user IDs for the sampled slices (CSV preferred). For SAML we'd like the parsed CSV plus the full XML blobs for three example assertions (we will treat those as high-sensitivity and delete after review).

Please prioritize:
- Signed bridge letter (PDF) by close of business Monday 2027-02-22
- Initial MFA authn CSV slices (sampled) for Oct–Nov 2026 by Tue 2027-02-23

If you can share the Drive link for the deliverables, we'll confirm receipt and then route to our assessor. Also, can you include the internal control narrative snippets Markus mentioned (1–2 short paragraphs mapping artifacts to SOC 2 CC3/CC6 where applicable)?

Thanks — Elaine
